target: false exclusion: a record excluded by the screening program that should have been kept

used_for: review of abstract-audit candidates that pass the frozen full-text screen
full_text.reviewers: two primary auditors from different vendors; a third only when both answers are valid and disagree; majority computed by code
response: criterion_results: one entry per criterion with supported (true/false) and page-level evidence
full_text.human_adjudication: only when the auditor majority says INCLUDE; a false exclusion is confirmed only when the human agrees and cites the page

inputs: complete abstract, or null when none exists
abstract.retain_rule: RETAIN unless the title and abstract clearly establish an exclusion; a RETAIN is a candidate, not an error
abstract.candidate_route: retrieve the full text and run the frozen full-text screen; a record the screen includes is reviewed in full_text mode

reason_codes.POTENTIALLY_ELIGIBLE: required for RETAIN_FOR_FULL_TEXT and for INCLUDE
reason_codes.{{C1_CODE}}: the material clearly establishes that criterion C1 fails
reason_codes.{{C2_CODE}}: the material clearly establishes that criterion C2 fails
reason_codes.{{C3_CODE}}: the material clearly establishes that criterion C3 fails

technical_failure: refusals, malformed output, missing fields and identity mismatches are retried with the same request; they never become an EXCLUDE, a vote or a clean round
